correctness.rationale: One-voter scoring marginal losses are 1/t_j for currently approved deleted candidates and b/(k t_j) for the average surviving winner. Since each actual deletion minimizes loss, five aggregate differences g01,g02,g1w,g12,g2w are <=0. The source supplies a nonnegative rational multiplier vector and explicit 8x2 nonnegative residual table, giving the first deletion bound; later deletions each <=1/(k+1) by two pointwise inequalities. An independently written rational checker verified the dual inequality for all eight deleted-ballot patterns, 0<=b<=k, 2<=k<=40 (finite corroboration only). The displayed symbolic residuals are rationally nonnegative for all integers k>=2 and b>=1. The source constructs integer profiles with n=k(3k+1)(k+2) and attains equality under allowed ties; direct fresh rational scoring verified the 252-voter k=6 example has unique minimum loss x,a,b in order: (62/3 vs127/6), (31 vs63/2), (33 vs100/3). Comparing B_k with 1/k gives exactly k=2..5 guaranteed and k>=6 counterexamples; k=1 follows from zero-loss unsupported alternative.
